rtl_guidelines.description: Full RTL support for Arabic using Tailwind logical properties
rules: Use ms-* and me-* instead of ml-* and mr-*
Use ps-* and pe-* instead of pl-* and pr-*
Use start-* and end-* instead of left-* and right-*
Use border-s-* and border-e-* instead of border-l-* and border-r-*
Add dir='rtl' attribute on HTML or body when Arabic is selected

landing.hero: 3D Floating logo using React Three Fiber. Background with subtle green/blue wavy particles. Deep dark background. Massive H1 typography.
landing.layout: Generous spacing (py-24 or py-32). Asymmetric 'Tetris' grid for feature highlights.

auth.layout: Split screen layout. Left side: Form with crystal glassmorphism. Right side: abstract dark minimal texture with slight green bleed.

onboarding.layout: Multi-step wizard centered on screen. Step indicator at top. Smooth slide transitions between steps using framer-motion.

dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (collapsible). Top-left North Star Metric. Dense 'Control Room' grid layout for KPI cards (col-span-1) and main Recharts visualizations (col-span-2 or 3).

reports.layout: Data table view of generated PDFs. 'Download Investor-Style Report' primary action prominently placed.

forecasting.layout: Interactive 3-scenario toggle (Optimistic, Realistic, Pessimistic) immediately impacting the main line graph below it. Colors: Green for Optimistic, Blue for Realistic, Zinc for Pessimistic.

ai_chat.layout: Dedicated panel or side-drawer. Glassmorphic chat bubbles. User messages: #2563eb (Blue). AI messages: Zinc-800 with white text.

images.description: AYMAFIN Main Brand Logo (3D bar chart with green money in a leaf/boat shape, blue rising bars)
Abstract black and green wavy lines for landing page atmospheric background
Dark green textured background for auth screen split layout

testing.rules: All interactive elements must include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='login-button')

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark mode Minimalist SaaS aesthetic (Vercel/Linear style).
Implement the 3D floating logo on the landing page using react-three-fiber.
Ensure complete RTL support using Tailwind logical properties (ms-, me-, ps-, pe-, start-, end-) for the Arabic language toggle. Add dir='rtl' to the html tag when Arabic is active.
Use JetBrains Mono specifically for KPI numbers, metrics, and monetary values in the dashboard.
Do NOT use pure black (#000000). Use #09090b (Zinc-950) with glassmorphism overlays (bg-white/5).
Use Recharts for the Cashflow/Expense charts and the 3-scenario forecasting views.
Ensure primary CTA uses Blue (#2563eb) and success/positive financial states use Green (#22c55e).
DO NOT USE INTER OR ROBOTO. Use Satoshi for Headings, Geist for body text, and JetBrains Mono for metrics.
